Restated before interest: AMGN paid $8,600mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 8.74% of revenue. Restated at replacement capex: AMGN spent $4,066mm on plant over 2023 to 2025 against $2,142mm of plant depreciation, 1.96% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. None recurs, so the charge stays nil. Restated to the amortisation floor: the filed cost lines leave a 28.28% pre-tax margin where the cash over 2023 to 2025 supports 43.05%, so the charge rebuilds at -14.77%. It was held at nil, but AMGN books $4,300mm of non-cash amortisation of acquired intangibles inside its cost lines in FY2025 (0000318154-26-000010), 11.70% of revenue, so the charge stops at that floor: -11.70%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 AMGN's cash flow statement shows receivables up $3,250mm, inventories down $3,909mm, payables up $338mm, a working capital release of $997mm, 1.01% of revenue. A release flatters the window once and does not recur, so the charge was held at the amortisation floor, -11.70% where the filed figures rebuild it at -14.77%, and stays there.

column11: a judgement.
